cards.ex: We need to raise awareness about the importance of mental health.
cards.exUz: Biz ruhiy salomatlikning ahamiyati haqida xabardorlikni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir muammo haqida odamlarning bilimini va tushunishini ko'paytirish.

cards.ex: The government is trying to tackle the problem of homelessness.
cards.exUz: Hukumat uysizlar muammosini hal qilishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Bir muammoga qarshi kurashish va uni yechishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Environmental groups are calling for action on climate change.
cards.exUz: Ekologik guruhlar iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha harakatga chaqirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qilish uchun qat'iy talab yoki murojaat qilish.

cards.ex: The social divide between rich and poor is growing wider.
cards.exUz: Boy va kambag'al o'rtasidagi ijtimoiy tafovut tobora kengayib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi odamlar o'rtasidagi farqlar, masalan, boylik yoki imkoniyatlar bo'yicha.

cards.ex: Many countries are still struggling with gender inequality in the workplace.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina davlatlar hali ham ish joylarida gender tengsizligi bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Erkaklar va ayollar o'rtasidagi teng huquqlar va imkoniyatlarning yo'qligi.

cards.ex: We need to consider the environmental impact of our choices.
cards.exUz: Biz o'z tanlovlarimizning ekologik ta'sirini hisobga olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Inson faoliyatining atrof-muhitga bo'lgan salbiy ta'siri.

cards.ex: The organization works to protect human rights around the world.
cards.exUz: Tashkilot butun dunyo bo'ylab inson huquqlarini himoya qilish uchun ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Har bir inson tug'ilganidan boshlab ega bo'lgan asosiy huquqlar va erkinliklar.

cards.ex: Climate change is a pressing issue that demands immediate attention.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi zudlik bilan e'tibor talab qiladigan dolzarb masala.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaqtda hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan juda muhim muammo.

cards.ex: The fight for social justice continues to this day.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy adolat uchun kurash bugungi kungacha davom etmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Har bir insonning teng huquqlarga va imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lishi.

cards.ex: Volunteering is a great way to make a difference in your community.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilik - bu jamiyatingizda o'zgarishga olib kelishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatish, vaziyatni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: The government is trying to level the playing field for small businesses.
cards.exUz: Hukumat kichik biznes uchun teng sharoitlar yaratishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli imkoniyatlar yaratish, teng sharoitlarni ta'minlash.

cards.ex: The environmental movement started as a grassroots movement.
cards.exUz: Ekologik harakat ommaviy harakat sifatida boshlangan.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamlar tomonidan boshlangan va tashkil etilgan harakat.

cards.ex: We need to address the root cause of poverty to solve the problem.
cards.exUz: Muammoni hal qilish uchun biz kambag'allikning asosiy sababini bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning eng chuqur va asosiy sababi.

cards.ex: We need to close the gap between rich and poor in education.
cards.exUz: Biz ta'limda boy va kambag'al o'rtasidagi farqni yo'qotishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar guruhlari o'rtasidagi tafovutni kamaytirish.

cards.ex: It's important to speak out against injustice.
cards.exUz: Adolatsizlikka qarshi gapirish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qarshi norozilik bildirish, ochiq tanqid qilish.

cards.ex: Many vulnerable people are falling through the cracks in the system.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina zaif odamlar tizimda e'tibordan chetda qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtoj bo'lgan, lekin e'tibordan chetda qolgan odamlar.

cards.ex: We can't turn a blind eye to the suffering of others.
cards.exUz: Biz boshqalarning azobiga ko'z yuma olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror noto'g'ri narsani ko'rib turib, bilmaganga olish.

cards.ex: She decided to take a stand against discrimination.
cards.exUz: U kamsitishga qarshi pozitsiya egallashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iy fikr bildirish, biror narsani himoya qilish.

cards.ex: Education can improve social mobility.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim ijtimoiy harakatchanlikni yaxshilashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning ijtimoiy mavqeini yaxshilash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: Investing in education will benefit society in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda jamiyatga foyda keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, uzoq vaqt davomida.

cards.ex: Public opinion is starting to shift on climate change.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha jamoatchilik fikri o'zgara boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning biror masala bo'yicha umumiy fikri.

cards.ex: Poverty and lack of education create a vicious cycle.
cards.exUz: Kambag'allik va ta'limning yetishmasligi yomon aylanishni yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: Bir muammoning boshqa muammoga olib kelishi va davom etishi.

cards.ex: Many families are facing food insecurity due to the economic crisis.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina oilalar iqtisodiy inqiroz tufayli oziq-ovqat tanqisligiga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning yetarli miqdorda oziq-ovqatga ega bo'lmasligi.

cards.ex: Access to healthcare should be a basic human right.
cards.exUz: Sog'liqni saqlash xizmatlaridan foydalanish asosiy inson huquqi bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Sog'liqni saqlash xizmatlaridan foydalanish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: Economic disparity is a major problem in many countries.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy tengsizlik ko'pgina mamlakatlarda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Boylikning noteng taqsimlanishi.

cards.ex: Businesses have a social responsibility to protect the environment.
cards.exUz: Bizneslar atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun ijtimoiy mas'uliyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyat oldidagi burch va javobgarlik hissi.

cards.ex: Racism is the elephant in the room that nobody wants to talk about.
cards.exUz: Irqchilik - bu hech kim gaplashishni xohlamaydigan yashirin muammo.
cards.uzDef: Hamma biladigan, lekin hech kim gapirmaydigan muammo.

cards.ex: Activists are pushing for change in the education system.
cards.exUz: Faollar ta'lim tizimida o'zgarishlarga intilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishlarni amalga oshirishga harakat qilish, rag'batlantirish.

cards.ex: Technology can be a double-edged sword.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya ikki tomonlama qilich bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ikkala yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The government needs to address the issue of unemployment.
cards.exUz: Hukumat ishsizlik masalasini hal qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammoga e'tibor qaratish va uni hal qilishga harakat qilish.
